title: Product-to-product relationships & dependency management (substitute/complement, catalog-only)
role: Agent-1 (Arena.ai) — Lead Developer / Architect / Full-Stack Executor

pull_request.body_preservation_rule: the 131474-char / 146932-byte prefix with sha256 c8fb45a7211bbd49bc59ceb38d8124a15d1a6a524ec8531204e08a69a1a00610 must remain byte-for-byte; C6 only appends

source_of_truth: migrations/0046_product_master.up.sql (product_relation: kind check substitute/complement, priority smallint default 100, unique(product_id, related_id, kind), check product_id <> related_id; product_bundle)
apps/api/src/modules/master-data/product-master.service.ts (pre-C6 controls: master.product.update, self_relation, relation_cycle for substitute, duplicate_relation, delete policy)

IMPLEMENTABLE.operational_effect: none — information only; no auto substitution in orders/invoices/waybills, no price/stock/COGS/document change
none — no bundle expansion or auto suggestion

BLOCKED: any third relationship kind without owner approval + migration
G-03 two-person approval / D4 policy replacement
new migrations, roles, grants, RLS, companies, seeds
UNRESOLVED: C6-D2 reciprocal/symmetric auto-creation (not implemented; reciprocal payload field rejected with 400)
C6-D3 complement cycles (no approved rule invented; not blocked)
C6-D4 cardinality / minimum or maximum requirements
C6-D5 blocking relationships to blocked/discontinued products (warn only)
UNSUPPORTED: relationship kinds outside the 0046 enum (validated: 400 validation_failed)
domain context on the central relation surface (400 domain_context_not_supported / domain_property_rejected)

GET /products/{id}/relations.returns: product, actor.can_update, kinds[], items[], counts, downstream_notes_fa, owner_decisions_fa

DELETE /products/{id}/relations/{relatio.scope: outgoing relation of this product only (existing policy)

security.company_identity: session only (AuthContext); company_id/tenant_id/actor_user_id in body or query => 400 forbidden_client_field
security.rls: product_relation RLS enabled + FORCE RLS, policies present (verified live via pg_class/pg_policy)
security.tenant_isolation: uniform 404 for unknown and cross-company products and for relations owned by another product
security.transaction: CatalogAccess.write (per-company advisory lock + GUC + fail-closed audit via recordRequired)
security.history: 0060 trigger in the same transaction; read surface exposes only action/target kind/priority/actor/time

gaps_closed: ProductCatalogController relation routes had no DomainBoundaryGuard -> now the whole C6 surface is guarded
relation reads did not call assertProduct -> unknown/cross-company product returned an empty 200; now uniform 404
no priority edit and no incoming-direction view -> PATCH priority + two-direction overview with editable/removable flags
documented_remaining_gaps: bundle/alias/attribute routes in ProductCatalogController still lack DomainBoundaryGuard and full assertProduct (out of C6 scope; input for C7/PM-B)
external clients of the removed /product-relations/{relationId} path must migrate to /products/{id}/relations/{relationId}

features: direction labels and per-kind grouping with counts
search-and-select product, kind, priority and explicit confirmation before POST
in-place priority edit and delete for outgoing rows only
bounded graph view and immutable history list
BLOCKED/UNRESOLVED decision register rendered in place

api_full_db_excluding_c6.baseline_comparison: /tmp/pm02c5-api-full.log — same 5 files / 19 titles (attachments/customers/geofences/tours/postgres-init-role), i.e. pre-existing/environmental, no C6 regression

live_evidence.environment: PostgreSQL 16.2 at 127.0.0.1:55432 (greendms_c1_preview) + API built from this tree on :4000 + Next.js on :3000
